packageRules.description: Hold major updates for review: label, soak, and never auto-merge
Batch GitHub Actions bumps into one PR
Keep the Go toolchain (go.mod) and the golang builder image in lockstep

Updates that change the shipped image (base images, Go toolchain/modules) land as fix(deps) so release-please cuts a release. config:recommended's :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers otherwise forces these to chore. github-actions stays chore (CI-only, no artifact change, no release).
